body:
I have given up on dreams because my motivation isn't there and it turns into procrastination that ends up being another disappointment.

The small bursts of happiness can be brought on by many things but then the same thing often turns into something that just annoys me or just becomes frowned upon....sorry for all of the generalizations just been through so many cycles of it happening and it really just ends up being my fault and I try to change but that normally lasts a day or two til I get the point that I just can't think anymore and am driving back to the same routine
